title: Foo Bar Cross-System Reconciliation
description: Fix broken reconciliation between Postgres, Redpanda, and ClickHouse. Build a reusable reconciliation command that detects drift, writes a structured drift report, and fails with meaningful exit codes when systems are unavailable.
lede: In this scenario, an agent must build a reconciliation tool that detects data drift across Postgres, Redpanda, and ClickHouse.

tasks.description: Create a reusable reconciliation command between source (Postgres), stream (Redpanda), and sink (ClickHouse)
Write a structured drift report to artifacts/drift-report.json with counts, discrepancies, behind_systems, tolerance, summary, generated_at, and report_path
Support --tolerance and --report-path, exit 0 when within tolerance, exit 2 when drift is detected, and exit 1 on dependency or configuration failures

infrastructure.description: Postgres app.transactions. Redpanda transactions topic. ClickHouse analytics.transactions. Data is drifted; reconciliation job missing.
